title: Keyboard Hero - Made a web game to help me learn keyboard
author: re-skob
selftext: I bought a little midi keyboard to play around with making music and since I have no idea how to make music I got GPT 5.6 Sol to make a Keyboard Hero game for me that hooks up to the keyboard and lets me practice, all within a few hours. What a time to be alive

comments.author: FunkMunki
comments.body: That's pretty awesome. What keyboard did you get?

comments.author: sendhelp
comments.body:
Very cool. I don't want to discourage you but there are apps similar to this already, synthesia and piano vision. Pianovision is particularly cool because it can be played in AR with a VR headset. You can import your own midis too.

They aren't web/HTML based though

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: yeah, I'm not planning on making this a paid for thing and will probably release it open source, but there's something about making my own so that I could customize it exactly to how I want to learn and with the hardware I have

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: just looked up pianovision and that does seem very cool. Will have to try it out

comments.body: Dude this is amazing, make a youtube tutorial!!!!!!!!
